## Type of change

## Checklist (required for new documents)

- [ ] Solves a real, named production problem
- [ ] Includes a decision matrix, formula, diagram, or copy-pasteable template
- [ ] "Last Verified" date is set in the document header
- [ ] Content is 100% original or sources are cited
- [ ] No vendor marketing without explicit disclosure
- [ ] Tested against the claim
